propositions: The deprecated bare environment variable REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed and replaced with a fail-loud tombstone error, as it was superseded by [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] slots and scheduled for removal before v1.0.0.

Model resolution must shift from env > config > default to CLI > config table > default, removing the env channel entirely while preserving the config key [tool.rebar.llm].model and per-class REBAR_LLM_<CLASS>_MODEL environment variables.
A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable must raise RemovedInputError at LLMConfig.from_env load time with a migration message, preventing silent behavioral changes to model selection.

All test files and documentation referencing REBAR_LLM_MODEL as a live mechanism must be retargeted to surviving config channels or the tombstone behavior, and prose must be reworded from deprecated to removed.
The deprecation registry row must be deleted with a historical NOTE, and a new tombstone row with behavior='error' must be added matching the REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS precedent.
